list.name: service
list.label: Project
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT service FROM events ORDER BY service;

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND $__timeFilter(received_at);
SELECT count(DISTINCT service) AS value FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND $__timeFilter(received_at);
SELECT count(DISTINCT type) AS value FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success') * 100.0 / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('success', 'failed')), 0))::numeric(5,1) AS value FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND $__timeFilter(received_at);
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND status = 'failed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at);
SELECT (count(*)::numeric / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo() - $__timeFrom())) / 60.0, 0))::numeric(10,2) AS value FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND $__timeFilter(received_at);
SELECT $__timeGroup(received_at, '5m') AS time, type AS metric, count(*)::float AS value FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;
SELECT type AS event_type, count(*)::bigint AS events FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15;
SELECT service AS "Service", type AS "Type", status AS "Status", count(*) AS "Count" FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT received_at AS "Время", service AS "Service", type AS "Type", status AS "Status", data AS "Data" FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT received_at AS "Время", service AS "Service", type AS "Type", data AS "Data", payload::text AS "Payload" FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND status = 'failed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 50;

panels.title: Последние поиски (scenario.completed)
panels.description: Только для проектов, шлющих type='scenario.completed' с payload.scenario (avia-style schema).

targets.rawSql: SELECT received_at AS "Время", service AS "Service", payload->'scenario'->>'user_email' AS "Email", data AS "Запрос", (payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int AS "Билетов", ((payload->'scenario'->'timings_ms'->>'total')::int / 1000.0)::numeric(10,1) AS "Sec", status AS "Статус", payload->'scenario'->>'aviasales_url' AS "URL" FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type = 'scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 100;
